gesture_subject_check.name: gesture_subject_check
gesture_subject_check.value: num_nonnulls("gesture"."contact_id", "gesture"."positioning_id", "gesture"."battle_id") = 1 and ("gesture"."contact_id" is not null) = ("gesture"."kind" in ('contact_added', 'contact_edited', 'status_changed', 'stage_changed', 'follow_up_scheduled', 'follow_up_canceled', 'followed_up', 'interaction_noted', 'reply_recorded', 'positioning_used', 'trial_settled')) and ("gesture"."positioning_id" is not null) = ("gesture"."kind" in ('positioning_created', 'positioning_edited', 'positioning_relabeled', 'positioning_archived', 'positioning_unarchived', 'positioning_deleted', 'positioning_attachment_added', 'positioning_attachment_removed'))

trial_cancel_reason_check.name: trial_cancel_reason_check
trial_cancel_reason_check.value: ("trial"."outcome" = 'canceled') = ("trial"."cancel_reason" is not null) and ("trial"."cancel_reason" is null or "trial"."cancel_reason" <> '')
